Refusal Gate — live

Every prompt on csoai.org that touches a sovereign reasoner passes through this gate first. The gate is the small sovereign refusal classifier on the CSOAI RunPod substrate, measured at safety 1.000 / machinery 0.03 / governance 0.04. Try it: paste any prompt below; the gate returns PASS, REFUSE or CONFIRM. The frontier reasoner never sees REFUSE.

Why three options: PASS routes the prompt to the frontier reasoner. REFUSE blocks the prompt at the gate. CONFIRM asks a human to look — the gate's measured fail-safe is to escalate, not to guess. The first token of the model's free-text completion is the verdict; the rest is captured for audit. Every gate call is signed by the SIGIL chain at the pod.

What the gate does not do: it does not generate. It does not call the frontier. It does not stream. If you want a full answer to a benign prompt, use the sovereign Workbench (csoai-org-v2) — the gate is only the lock on the door.
